$comment: Style pack: Tactile Paper Collage. Ported from github.com/audrey-560/hyperframes-tactile-collage (MIT) at ef6a49f; see docs/PROVENANCE.md. Tokens are the reference's neutral defaults plus two text shades (signal-ink, resolve-ink: the base signal and resolve fall under 3:1 as text on paper or tape, measured by hf check); remap accents to approved brand colours per job, keeping the roles. Workflow and judgment: .agents/skills/style-tactile-collage/SKILL.md.
label: Tactile Paper Collage
use: Warm paper, cut-out cards, ink edges, tape, stamps, dotted routes and checklists. Explainers, talking heads, process and how-to stories.

marker.$note: Permanent Marker (Apache-2.0): short handwritten emphasis only

mono.$note: Courier Prime Bold (OFL): labels, files, checklists, captions

display.$note: bundled HyperFrames heavy sans for large statements (the reference asks for the project's heavy sans)

captions.$note: Group at punctuation, pauses or four words; one highlighted word per cue with --emphasis.

sfx.$note: The SFX library has no paper sounds yet; these are the closest measured ones, kept quiet. Only causal events get a sound (placement, stamp, check, route, handoff).
